entries.reentry_latch: main+0x10f2 is set across the modal path; busy and cancel branches retain their observed 0x10f0/0x10f1 changes

state_ownership.initialization: deep-copy main vector; selected record default-initialized; load_ok=1; undo_available=0; undo vector empty
state_ownership.copy_and_assignment: 0x414f60/0x416cf0 allocate/copy 0xac-byte records and 0x402d80 copies seven string objects; not pointer-only aliasing
state_ownership.destruction: 0x416380 destroys dialog widgets, string fields and both lists; it is not a save/commit routine

record.string_layout_scope: fixed-x86 in-memory small-string layout; wire/file stores lengths and bytes, never 24-byte object images
record.encoding: raw narrow bytes; this validator does not validate a codepage or UTF-8; bytes >=128 pass this byte-class check

file.path_builder: 0x425320 takes the directory of controller+0x775c using the last slash/backslash and appends LaunchPresets.dat
layout: count * (u32le type; seven * (u32le byteLength; exact bytes))
file.decoder: 0x419d40 uses 0x429430 little-endian reads, length<=512 and remaining-byte checks, per-record 0x429980 validation, exact EOF; swaps the completed temporary vector into the destination only on success
file.duplicates: encoder/decoder do not check name uniqueness; duplicate-name files are not rejected by this grammar alone

file_reader.zero_file_bytes: read failure, not an empty-list file

writer.failure: return false; delete the self-created temporary file after a write/flush/replace failure; create-new failure does not delete an already-existing collision file
writer.not_verified: actual Windows fault handling, filesystem atomicity, crash durability and platform adapters

list_workflow.rule: persistent mode reloads the file into current list; session mode uses copied main list; read failure clears displayed list, disables mutation and preserves main list at close
valid selection controls primary-button enablement; double click also invokes choose
0x422890 requires primary-button focus; 0x429910 validates selected index, copies record to dialog+0xcc and delegates modal result 1
edit an isolated record copy, change only field 0, on accepted editor result modify candidate vector; validate/persist candidate before changing visible current vector
require confirmation result 1; remove candidate row and clamp selection to last remaining index; validate/persist before publication
swap selected row with index-1 only within bounds; validate/persist before publication
swap selected row with index+1 only within bounds; validate/persist before publication
save previous current vector as single undo snapshot, swap candidate into current, set undo_available=1 and refresh list/selection
require load_ok and undo_available; validate/persist snapshot before swap; clear undo_available and consume previous snapshot; no redo stack
when load_ok is true, copy current list back to main BEFORE testing modal result; prior successful list writes and edits survive cancellation; only result 1 calls apply-selected 0x428c00
persistent mode reloads file, session mode copies main list; the one-step undo snapshot is local to the destroyed dialog

editor.submission: require primary-button HWND focus; get edit 7921; trim trailing then leading CRT multibyte whitespace; assign name; validate entire record; compare names using __mbsicmp excluding edited row; only then call modal-OK helper
editor.limits: edit control receives limit 64; record validator applies 64 raw bytes to name; do not treat this as 64 Unicode characters
editor.cancel: local editor copy destroyed; no candidate-list publication or file write from cancelled editor
editor.default_name: 0x41d6a0 omits control bytes and limits generated narrow name to 32 bytes without splitting an observed DBCS lead-byte pair; full source-name composition remains tied to catalog context

add_current.rule: clone main list; reload first when persistent; reject failed read or list size >=32; modal editor result 1 appends record; serialize/write when persistent; publish to main only after success; cancel/write failure returns AL=0
add_current.record_origin: 0x419a40 gates selected game-ID state and calls 0x4195f0; summary labels and field copies bind account/game-ID and catalog selection, not a new authentication exchange

known_conditions: game type and secondary identity match
optional subrealm empty or uniquely matches according to catalog count
apply_selected_boundary.known_effect: copies selected record, resets local selection state and invokes existing game/realm/subrealm and next-stage helpers

design_inferences: D1 should add a separate shared preset-list owner/codec and one-step undo; the legacy UserMode-only preference module does not implement this grammar.
Thin web/WeChat adapters should translate accepted actions and persistence outcomes; cancellation must not silently roll back already-published list changes.
pending: Complete catalog identity meanings and all apply-selected/next-stage state, error, cancellation and reentry conditions.
Exact runtime multibyte locale, trim and case-comparison behavior; do not substitute arbitrary Unicode folding.
Complete native framework delivery/focus/keyboard lifecycle and UI presentation, including the checking helper inside the derived command bridges.
File format is fixed c82f only; other launcher versions and the current official distribution are not proven equivalent.
Implementations, platform persistence, actual device operation and same-version official acceptance await the global analysis gate.
